response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, deep technical versatility, and demonstrated leadership in open-source and team mentoring, but lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years in production-grade GenAI or cloud-based AI system delivery, with only recent AI-agent work at re:cinq and no clear RAG, vector DB, or multi-agent framework experience highlighted.
strengths: Proven full-stack engineering leadership with diverse tech stack mastery (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang)
Active open-source contributor with real-world impact (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and driving engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, code kata)
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years in GenAI or cloud AI system delivery; recent AI-agent work may not meet seniority threshold
Missing explicit experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph
Limited documentation of cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) deep integration in AI contexts beyond CDK usage
